subject: Launch window constraints and exception pathway
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Park <alyssa@craftly.ai>
Date: 2027-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Launch window constraints and exception pathway

Team —

We need to lock the launch window for the Craftly pilot next week and agree an exception pathway for the one remaining safety gating item (rate-limit logging for third-party webhooks). Key asks:

- Can infra guarantee the rollout window 2027-07-07 to 2027-07-09 for the hosted SKU (no config changes post-10:00PT on 7/7)?
- Product asks: is a partial enablement (hosted only, manual rollback) acceptable to the customer if the webhook issue persists?
- Docs: who will own an emergency short-form playbook (2-pager) and the customer-facing note?
- Sales: reconciliation on whether BrownCap procurement needs the final SOC attestation before the start date — they pushed their procurement review to this week.

I attached the current enablement deck (v1) and the exception log. We need a single comment thread with explicit owners and a binary go/no-go by COB PDT today.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch window constraints and exception pathway

Tessa —

Infra can commit the window 2027-07-07 00:00 PT through 2027-07-09 23:59 PT for the hosted SKU with the following constraints:

- No infra-level config or kernel updates during the window (we'll put a freeze).
- We need final model artifact pin by 7/6 18:00 PT to bake caches and verify profiling.
- If the webhook rate-limit logging causes queue backpressure, we will enable an automated degrade to the fallback webhook proxy (5–10% increased p99) — requires a short config toggle that Marcus Ops will own.

Action: Vivek and I will validate the automated degrade path and provide a smoke checklist by 3pm PT today.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal SRE, Serving Runtime
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Alyssa Park <alyssa@craftly.ai>
Date: 2027-06-30T11:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch window constraints and exception pathway

Tessa / team —

I can own the emergency 2-pager playbook and the customer-facing note. Two quick questions:
1) Do we want the internal playbook to include runbook steps for a manual rollback vs. the automated degrade? I recommend both, with the automated degrade as the primary path.
2) For the customer note — do we want to proactively mention the webhook-rate item as an exception or keep it under "post-launch monitoring" language?

I'll draft both documents and share links by 2pm PT. Leaning to proactive transparency (mention as an exception with mitigation) — keeps trust and avoids surprises.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Technical Writer
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Alyssa Park <alyssa@craftly.ai>
Cc: BrownCap Procurement <procure@browncap.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T12:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch window constraints and exception pathway

Tessa / Alyssa —

Quick procurement update from BrownCap: their legal/procurement team says they can proceed with a pilot agreement that references our standard data processing terms, but BrownCap's procurement lead needs the SOC attestation PDF by 7/1 EOD PT to avoid delaying their internal kick-off. If we can't get the attestation over, they want to move the start to 7/14.

Alyssa: if you can confirm BrownCap is comfortable with the small exception path (degrade + manual rollback) we can surface that in the note. Otherwise, they're likely to request the later window.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch window constraints and exception pathway

Confirmed — Marcus and I validated the automated degrade and manual rollback steps. Short summary:

- Automated degrade: toggle on fallback webhook proxy (tested in staging), adds +8% p99; automatic routing returns to normal after 30m with no manual intervention.
- Manual rollback: documented steps require DB read-only mode + model roll-back by images; estimated time-to-restore baseline is 18–27 minutes with current on-call cadence.

I'll add the smoke checklist to ENG-845 and drop the link in the drive folder. We recommend ship with automated degrade as primary mitigation and the manual rollback as an emergency secondary.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Platform Engineering
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Park <alyssa@craftly.ai>, BrownCap Procurement <procure@browncap.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch window constraints and exception pathway — owners and decision

Thanks everyone — final call and owners below: 

- Go window: 2027-07-07 to 2027-07-09 (Infra freeze in effect). Owner: Marcus Lin — confirm freeze by 3pm PT 6/30.
- Mitigation: Automated degrade = primary. Owner: Vivek Kulkarni (implement and sanity-check).
- Manual rollback playbook: Owner: Vivek + Lauren (Lauren to add human-readable steps into the 2-pager).
- Customer note + 2-pager: Owner: Lauren Bishop (share draft by 2pm PT; publish to Drive in folder).
- SOC attestation delivery: Owner: Marissa Cole (please upload PDF to Drive and confirm to Ben by 7/1 EOD PT).

Decision: If SOC attestation cannot be provided by 7/1 EOD PT, BrownCap will request moving the start to 7/14; otherwise proceed with the 7/07 window with mitigations above.

Action items (owners + deadlines):
- Marcus: confirm infra freeze by 15:00 PT today.
- Vivek: post smoke checklist to ENG-845 and validate degrade toggle in production-like canary by 15:00 PT today.
- Lauren: draft and publish 2-pager + customer note to Drive by 14:00 PT today.
- Marissa: upload SOC attestation PDF and notify Ben by 7/1 EOD PT.
- Ben: confirm BrownCap acceptance once SOC attestation is uploaded or notify Tessa if they request the 7/14 start.

I'll follow up with a consolidated playbook link once Lauren publishes. If any owner cannot meet the deadlines, flag immediately in this thread.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
